steps.content: After the shooting is done, instead of heading straight back to the Bureau, you go to Poffy's little rented home.
In that warm little apartment filled with stuffed animals, Poffy cooks a full pot of steaming, fluffy rice.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Go ahead, dig in! Promise I cook the best rice ever! Though it's pretty much the only thing I can cook...
Poffy hands you a spoon and dives into her own meal. Even though she just won the eating contest, she still seems ravenous, devouring even the plain white rice with gusto.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Mmm!! After-work feasts are simply the best! I'm the happiest person in the world!
The inevitable result of consuming too much rice is that you both end up in a carb coma.
Poffy sits on the soft carpet in front of the couch, chattering away about what happened earlier.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: To be honest... I know that Mom was suffering too. She was having mental health issues, but she was too busy with me to see a doctor.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Even though she kicked me out, she'd slipped a lot of cash in my suitcase, enough for me to live comfortably in Eastside for years... But I was stupid and got scammed by a shady rental agent, so the landlord kicked me out.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: When I was homeless, I met Lumy. Kind as she is, she found me a cheap place. There were even folks running around upstairs at night, so I didn't feel as scared being alone...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When you said folks, did you mean ghosts?!
Poffy ignores your shock, shoveling down a couple more spoonfuls of rice as she continues her story.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Later, when the company started exploiting me but I couldn't afford the penalty to break my contract, Lumy was the one who told me I could ask the Bureau for help.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: At first, I was terrified that I'd get dragged off to some horrible place and locked up, like in the movies. But Lumy said you're really kind and that you'd definitely help me! She said you wouldn't leave a stray Sinner out there to be bullied!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: She said everyone in the Bureau is really nice, and that I'd make friends with other Sinners. Plus, the cafeteria has great food served with unlimited rice!

options: ...So you really just came to the Bureau to mooch free meals?

choices.text: ...So you really just came to the Bureau to mooch free meals?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: You really are just as Lumy described! You're so kind, hic, the kindest person I've met!

Poffy beams, cupping her face in her hands. Her expression looks completely different than in the streaming studio. You see a beautiful smile that can stop people in their tracks, from genuine happiness radiating from within.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Since you're so nice to me, I'll let you in on my secret.
Poffy turns on her streaming device and pulls up a group chat.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Actually, when I first started streaming, I just wanted to share what I was eating every day. I never expected I'd end up making money out of it.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: My fan group only had about ten people at first... They watched my streams every day, talked to me on voice chats, recommended new restaurants for me to check out, and encouraged me to get sponsors...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Later, someone from the talent agency reached out to me, so I signed with them. They started arranging my daily streaming content and the products for my mukbang videos, asked me to do gimmicky things, and signed me up for sponsorship deals I didn't even like.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: My numbers really did keep growing, but I couldn't tell who was real and who was fake anymore. I had no idea if they actually enjoyed watching my eating videos, or if they were just paid accounts.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I didn't know if I could still feel genuinely happy eating all these weird foods. I had no idea who I was even trying to impress by acting happy.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Then later... my small group of OG fans got drowned out in the crowd, and I never saw them again... But I've kept all the cute little fanarts they made of me! Saved in a cloud album where I can look at them anytime I want!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: This little seal is a profile pic one of my fans drew for me. Isn't it adorable? I sewed the little seal onto my clothes, so it's like they're still with me...
As Poffy continues, she suddenly looks gloomy again.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: If... if they saw me eating all this gross food and giving fake praise that goes against everything I believe... they'd be so disappointed in me, wouldn't they? Poffy is no longer that girl they used to like. They're never coming back...
After such an exhausting day, little Poffy slowly drifts off to sleep while murmuring to herself softly.
She lies on the living room couch as the sky begins brightening up. In just a little while, fresh morning sunlight will pour through the windows, illuminating her sleeping face.

You cover Poffy with a thin blanket, your gaze passing over that fan group with only a dozen members. The chat history shows fewer and fewer messages over time, and only Poffy's profile picture is still active.
You move to a quiet corner to make a phone call.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've gathered all the evidence. We can start preparing.
[Scene Change]
One month later
The kettle lets out a sharp whistle, and you quickly grab it to pour hot water into your cup noodles. Three minutes later, slurping instant noodles, you watch Poffy's stream replay.
The stream title reads: Celebrating Poffy's 100 Followers! ^^
A month ago, soon after you made that phone call at Poffy's place, you received a reply from Mr. Fox.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: I've made some interesting discoveries. While they're not enough to completely destroy that MCN company, we could easily use them to free that innocent girl from their grasp.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: Of course, she'll still need to pay a portion of the liquidated damages, and she'll lose access to her account. However, they'll also need to compensate Miss Poffy for emotional damages.

Mr. Fox's good news brought great relief, but you didn't tell Poffy immediately. Instead, you waited until everything was nearly finalized before bringing her back to the MCN building for a meeting with the executives.
Poffy didn't disappoint you. Faced with those people, she suddenly found her backbone.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: You are all horrible liars! I'm not the only one you've tricked into signing these contracts!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I'm the only thing you're losing this time. But next time, and next next time, I hope you lose everything you've stolen from others with your dirty schemes!

steps.speaker: Manager
steps.content: You...!
The manager's raised arm made Poffy instinctively duck behind you. But you weren't disappointed by this show of fear. Quite the opposite, you felt deeply reassured.
You see? Poffy took your advice. When you need help, just ask. You're not alone in this world.
Perhaps because the weight of debt was lifted off her shoulders, the newly freed Poffy smiled exceptionally happily that day.
With Mr. Fox's help, Poffy terminated her contract with MCN and gave up her account.
She started a new account that was entirely her own. In her spare time, she actively participated in special power training at the Bureau while undergoing routine examinations.

After the final examination report came in, Poffy qualified for home supervision and was released from the Bureau. She now only needs to check in periodically and report her location and health condition.
But just thinking about the white rice party she threw in the cafeteria on her last day makes your stomach feel heavy...
Knock, knock. Someone knocks on the office door, and you scramble to close the replay video.
Poffy pushes open the door and bounces over to you, shoving aside your half-eaten cup of instant noodles with sausage and filling your view with two large bags of food.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Instant noodles? That's so unhealthy!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: These are all treats my sponsors sent me, and I brought them especially for you! Chewy octopus legs and new desserts!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Hehe, I've got good news! My top fan said they want to send me a congratulatory gift for hitting 100 followers!
Poffy beams with a radiant smile, her eyes sparkling as she looks at you. You avert your gaze and rub your hands together unnaturally.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: But too bad they'll have to pay for shipping to send the gift. I want to save my fan a few dimes, so I rushed right over after my stream ended!
Poffy spreads her palm and holds it in front of you, grinning mischievously.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: So, my number one fan, where's my gift? Come on, hand it over!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I thought I hid it well.
You mutter under your breath and reluctantly pull out your personal device, navigating to the video gallery before handing it to Poffy.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: A video? It's titled... A Challenge Invitation to Miss Poffy?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Chief, I had no idea you knew how to edit videos! Did you actually make this yourself?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Go ahead and play it. I think you'll really like it.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: You're hyping it up so much I'm actually getting nervous... Honestly.
Poffy pats her chest lightly to manage her expectations before solemnly pressing the play button with her index finger.
On screen, encouraging messages scroll by alongside familiar usernames and profile pictures. Poffy's eyes fill with tears.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: You... you found them!
Then, a girl she's never seen before appears on screen, holding a tiny seal ornament in her hands. The moment her voice comes through, Poffy recognizes her.

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: Poffy? Of course I remember her! You know that little seal avatar she's been using this whole time? I drew it! Isn't it so cute?

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: Actually, Poffy and I are very different. When I see food, no matter how delicious it looks, I just can't bring myself to eat it.

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: I'm so thin. It's not attractive or healthy at all. But everyone says they envy how skinny I am, that I never have to worry about gaining weight... But deep down... I'm envious of Poffy, who enjoys food so much.

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: I could tell that after signing with the company, Poffy was being forced to diet in extreme ways to maintain her figure. Did I guess right? So many times I noticed she looked really unwell, but I didn't know how to reach out to her, so I drew that little seal instead.

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: I wanted her to see that chubby, mochi-like little seal and know that it is healthy and cute in its own way. To me, Poffy is that little seal. She has the perfect body shape as long as she's healthy. It's the sweet, soft Poffy that I've always adored.

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: Poffy's mukbang videos are the only thing that stimulates my appetite... In a way, Poffy has saved my life.

steps.speaker: Overweight Fan
steps.content: Well... You see, I'm fat.

steps.speaker: Overweight Fan
steps.content: I used to have really low self-esteem. I, I also stutter a little when I talk, so I never really had any friends.

steps.speaker: Overweight Fan
steps.content: But one day, I saw Poffy eating. S-she was so confident, and she loved food, just like me. But she wasn't ashamed of it, which was r-really good. Because of her, I started learning to accept myself too.

steps.speaker: Overweight Fan
steps.content: Poffy taught me that being fat was n-never something to be ashamed of.

steps.speaker: Angry Fan
steps.content: Hehe, just like Poffy, when I'm hungry, I start losing my temper. When it gets really bad, I even end up hurting others. But amazingly, whenever I watch Poffy's eating streams, it always helps calm me down.

steps.speaker: Angry Fan
steps.content: I kept coming back to her videos. After watching so many, one day I suddenly realized I was learning to control my temper, and hunger was no longer so frightening.

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: I came to understand that eating both too much and too little are unhealthy.

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: It must have taken a lot of courage to terminate your contract with the company and start a new life. I can see you're trying to change for the better! So I'll keep working hard too.

steps.speaker: Little Seal Fan
steps.content: I hope that one day, we can all confidently tell ourselves: We're finally in control of our own bodies, and look how healthy and happy we are!

steps.speaker: Overweight Fan
steps.content: To be honest, I still don't like my chubby appearance, b-but I just can't bring myself to commit to losing weight. It's just so hard... Now that I'm seeing you again and witnessing how you're starting a new life, you've given me a lot of strength to improve as well.

steps.speaker: Overweight Fan
steps.content: This time, I-I will be like you. I won't run away from my true thoughts anymore. I m-might never become conventionally fit, but I want to be pretty like you!

steps.speaker: Overweight Fan
steps.content: Let's work hard together! I'll catch up to you soon!

steps.speaker: Angry Fan
steps.content: To tell you the truth, when you were doing those weird mukbang streams, I posted many mean comments mocking you. I thought you were just doing that for attention. It was so lame.

steps.speaker: Angry Fan
steps.content: But you're different now. Actually, no. I should say you look just like yourself when you first started streaming.

steps.speaker: Angry Fan
steps.content: For a while, I felt betrayed by you. How could you get better? We're supposed to be beaten down by society, living every day miserably, doing things we don't want to do. But I quickly realized that I had never been able to accept the fact that I was sick.

steps.speaker: Angry Fan
steps.content: Thank you for helping me recognize my wrong behavior. I'm going to therapy regularly now. I hope that one day... I'll be able to formally apologize to you in your comment section.
For a moment, Poffy's choked sobs are the only sound in the office. Tears dampen the screen, the video paused where the fans are giving Poffy a thumbs up.
You hand her some tissues thoughtfully. Once she's managed to collect herself, you take out a handmade seal plushie and give it to Poffy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This was handmade by that fan of yours. She asked me to give it to you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They all wanted me to tell you this: No matter how many times you change your account, they'll always follow you and watch your videos. And if you ever want to chat, they'll always be there for you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They liked you in the past, and they like you now. As long as you're being yourself, they'll always be your fans. Because that's the real Poffy no one else gets to define.
As Poffy runs her fingers over the stitches of the little seal plushie, the tears she has just managed to stop begin falling again.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I, I never thought... that someday I could be a source of strength for someone else...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Actually, I was worried at first that I might have made a mistake. Would the new me end up disappointing the people who liked the old me? I felt lost about that for so long...
Poffy quickly goes through the entire pack of tissues. She grabs her sleeve and rubs her eyes before lifting her head to look at you.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Thank you, Chief! Thank you for helping me find them, recording these videos, and bringing me their gifts. Hearing their encouragement and seeing their faces have helped me accept myself more and more!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Chief, you... did so much for me without me knowing... Thank you for noticing my worries, helping me through my struggles, and even encouraging me to start my new account. You helped me get to where I am today... Ah, I'm gonna cry again, sob...
Poffy's tearful, emotional smile overwhelms you a little as well. You clear your throat, signaling for her to listen to what you're about to say.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Those were all gifts from your fans. I haven't given you my gift yet.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's not an expensive or nostalgic gift. It's not handmade either. Um... unless a handwritten card counts as well.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I hope Miss Poffy, who's just reached a hundred fans, won't despise my gift.
Poffy takes the card from your hand, flips it over, and sees a line of text.
The next second, she clutches the card and rushes over to hug you, crying loudly.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What's going on?! Chief, did something happen?!
Nightingale rushes through the door looking extremely worried, only to witness the scene unfolding before her. The situation immediately spirals out of control.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Chief! You're the best! Boohoo, wahhhh, why don't you just detain me? I don't ever want to leave anymore! I can stream from the Bureau! Wahhhhh!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What? Streaming from the Bureau? Chief, that's against our rules!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No, Nightingale, let me explain. That's not what Poffy means...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Chief! Wahhhh! I love you so much, Chief!!!
Amid the chaos, the card slips from Poffy's hand and falls onto the desk.

This is a spell to control yourself. When you feel anxious, recite it three times:
Take a deep breath and relax
I can control my body
I can control my desires
I can calm my fears
I am in full control of myself and I can do this
[Scene Change]
Before leaving the Bureau, Poffy waves at you and mysteriously gestures for you to lean your ear closer.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: In fact... I set up my own arrest by the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I had someone write you an anonymous letter and provide the leads. So the whole lurking glutton incident... Well, I made it up.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I never actually lost control from hunger and attacked innocent passersby. I might have slipped up once or twice in the past, but I definitely wouldn't have let it happen a third time.
Poffy gives a cheerful laugh and waves goodbye to you. You say nothing, watching the direction she left in, and find yourself smiling too.
You open your work journal to the new evaluation you wrote some time after Poffy resolved her contract issues with MCN.
No plans, but plenty of ideas. No acting skills, but full of courage.
Since she wants to believe that she can create her own new beginning and shape her own path...
Then it's all good.
